app.title: RapidTools
app.toolsSubtitle: Quick conversion for image, video and audio.

common.pleaseWait: This may take a few seconds.
common.batchReadyCopy: Send files, pick the final format, and download each output or a ZIP with everything.

image.name: Image Converter
image.description: Convert images to PNG, JPG, WEBP, HEIC, AVIF, and ENC with individual or batch downloads.
image.hint: Ideal for exporting assets for web, social, apps, and design libraries.
image.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, AVIF, and ENC.
image.emptyCopy: Upload several images, choose the final format, and download each converted file or a ZIP of the batch.

video.name: Video Converter
video.blurb: Convert MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV and AVI
video.description: Convert videos between MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, and AVI with individual or batch downloads.
video.hint: Useful for standardizing edit, web, and sharing formats.
video.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, and AVI.
video.emptyCopy: Upload several videos, choose the final container, and download each output or a ZIP of the batch.

image_resizer.name: Image Resizer
image_resizer.blurb: Resize for social, stores and thumbnails
image_resizer.description: Resize images with contain, cover, or stretch fit and export in the format you need.
image_resizer.hint: Mental presets for social, stores, and thumbnails.
image_resizer.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP.
image_resizer.emptyCopy: Set width, height, and fit; download each result or the ZIP package.

video_compressor.name: Video Compressor
video_compressor.blurb: Reduce file size for sharing and upload
video_compressor.description: Compress videos to MP4 with quality presets and resolution caps.
video_compressor.hint: Ideal for reducing size before upload or publishing.
video_compressor.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, and AVI.
video_compressor.emptyCopy: Pick preset and resolution; download the compressed MP4 or the batch ZIP.

extract_audio.name: Extract Audio from Video
extract_audio.blurb: Pull MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC and FLAC from video
extract_audio.description: Extract the audio track from videos to MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, or FLAC.
extract_audio.hint: Fast for podcasts, samples, and offline captioning.
extract_audio.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, and TS.
extract_audio.emptyCopy: Upload videos and download each extracted audio or the batch ZIP.

audio.name: Audio Converter
audio.blurb: Convert MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC and FLAC
audio.description: Convert audio between MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, and FLAC with individual or batch downloads.
audio.hint: Standardize sound libraries and product assets.
audio.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, and FLAC.
audio.emptyCopy: Upload several audio files, choose the final format, and download each file or the ZIP.

photos_to_pdf.name: Photos to PDF
photos_to_pdf.blurb: Reorder images and export a single PDF
photos_to_pdf.description: Combine photos into a single PDF to share or print.
photos_to_pdf.hint: Useful for reports, portfolios, and simple documents.
photos_to_pdf.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, AVIF, and ENC.
photos_to_pdf.emptyCopy: Select images in the desired order and export the PDF.

pdf_to_images.name: PDF to images
pdf_to_images.blurb: Rasterize PDF pages to PNG or JPG
pdf_to_images.description: Convert PDF pages into PNG or JPG images.
pdf_to_images.hint: Part of the RapidTools document workflow.
pdf_to_images.emptyCopy: Upload a PDF and download each rasterized page or the ZIP.

together_audios.name: Together Audios
together_audios.blurb: Join multiple audio files into one track
together_audios.description: Join two or more audio files into a single output.
together_audios.acceptHelp: Select at least 2 audio files (MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC).
together_audios.emptyCopy: Choose the final format and download the unified track.

together_videos.name: Together Videos
together_videos.blurb: Join multiple video files into one track
together_videos.description: Join two or more videos into a single output file.
together_videos.acceptHelp: Select at least 2 videos (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI).
together_videos.emptyCopy: Choose the final container and download the unified video.

images_to_video.name: Images to Video
images_to_video.blurb: Turn photos into MP4 or GIF
images_to_video.description: Turn a sequence of images into an MP4 or animated GIF.
images_to_video.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP.
images_to_video.emptyCopy: Upload images in order and export MP4 or GIF.

qr_reader.name: QR Reader
qr_reader.blurb: Decode QR codes from images or camera
qr_reader.description: Decode QR codes from image files with zbarimg.
qr_reader.hint: On desktop, use image upload (browser camera remains on the web app).
qr_reader.acceptHelp: Accepted inputs: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP.
qr_reader.emptyCopy: Upload an image with a QR code to see the decoded payload.
